```{=html}
<div class="teaching-demo" id="sleep-calculator" data-demo="sleep" role="region" aria-labelledby="sleep-demo-title">
  <div class="demo-heading"><div><p class="demo-eyebrow">Try it · A battery budget</p><h3 id="sleep-demo-title" class="unnumbered">What uses the battery while you sleep?</h3></div><button type="button" data-fullscreen hidden>Enlarge demo</button></div>
  <p>Change the current and time spent in each state. Compare the share of time spent awake with its share of the battery charge used.</p>
  <div class="sleep-workbench">
    <div class="sleep-inputs">
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-active-current">Awake current <span>(mA)</span></label><input id="sleep-active-current-number" type="number" aria-label="Average total battery current while awake, milliamps" min="1" max="500" step="1" value="80"><input id="sleep-active-current" type="range" min="1" max="500" step="1" value="80"></div>
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-idle-current">Sleep current <span>(µA)</span></label><input id="sleep-idle-current-number" type="number" aria-label="Total battery current while asleep, microamps" min="0" max="5000" step="1" value="50"><input id="sleep-idle-current" type="range" min="0" max="5000" step="1" value="50"></div>
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-active-time">Time awake <span>(s)</span></label><input id="sleep-active-time-number" type="number" aria-label="Time awake per cycle, seconds" min="0.1" max="60" step="0.1" value="2"><input id="sleep-active-time" type="range" min="0.1" max="60" step="0.1" value="2"></div>
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-idle-time">Time asleep <span>(s)</span></label><input id="sleep-idle-time-number" type="number" aria-label="Time asleep per cycle, seconds" min="0" max="3600" step="1" value="58"><input id="sleep-idle-time" type="range" min="0" max="3600" step="1" value="58"></div>
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-capacity">Battery capacity <span>(mAh)</span></label><input id="sleep-capacity-number" type="number" aria-label="Rated battery capacity, milliamp hours" min="100" max="10000" step="1" value="2000"><input id="sleep-capacity" type="range" min="100" max="10000" step="1" value="2000"></div>
      <div class="sleep-control"><label for="sleep-usable">Usable capacity <span>(%)</span></label><input id="sleep-usable-number" type="number" aria-label="Usable fraction of rated battery capacity, percent" min="10" max="100" step="1" value="80"><input id="sleep-usable" type="range" min="10" max="100" step="1" value="80"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sleep-results">
      <dl class="demo-stats"><div><dt>Average current</dt><dd id="sleep-average">2.715 mA</dd></div><div><dt>Estimated runtime</dt><dd id="sleep-runtime">24.6 days</dd></div><div><dt>Runtime vs always awake</dt><dd id="sleep-gain">29.5×</dd></div></dl>
      <p id="sleep-budget" class="sleep-budget">1,600 mAh usable · 589.3 hours estimated. Always awake: 20.0 hours.</p>
      <figure class="demo-plot sleep-breakdown"><svg id="sleep-plot" viewBox="0 0 600 245" role="img" aria-labelledby="sleep-plot-title sleep-plot-description"><title id="sleep-plot-title">Time and battery charge per cycle</title><desc id="sleep-plot-description">Awake for 3.3 percent of the time, using 98.2 percent of the charge.</desc><text x="18" y="24">Time per cycle</text><rect x="18" y="38" width="564" height="32" rx="3" class="sleep-bar-idle"></rect><rect id="sleep-time-bar" x="18" y="38" width="18.8" height="32" class="sleep-bar-active"></rect><text id="sleep-time-label" x="18" y="96">Awake 3.3% · asleep 96.7%</text><text x="18" y="145">Battery charge per cycle</text><rect x="18" y="159" width="564" height="32" rx="3" class="sleep-bar-idle"></rect><rect id="sleep-charge-bar" x="18" y="159" width="554" height="32" class="sleep-bar-active"></rect><text id="sleep-charge-label" x="18" y="217">Awake 98.2% · asleep 1.8%</text></svg><figcaption><span class="sleep-legend-active">Orange: awake</span><span class="sleep-legend-idle">Blue: asleep</span></figcaption></figure>
      <p id="sleep-cycle" class="sleep-cycle">One cycle = 2 s awake + 58 s asleep = 60 s.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="demo-presets" aria-label="Example timing schedules"><button type="button" data-timing="2,58">1-minute cycle</button><button type="button" data-timing="2,298">5-minute cycle</button><button type="button" data-timing="2,0">No sleep</button></div>
  <p class="demo-formula" id="sleep-formula">Iavg = (80 × 2 + 0.05 × 58) / 60 = 2.715 mA</p>
  <details class="demo-explanation"><summary>How is battery life estimated?</summary><p>Average current = (awake current × awake time + sleep current × sleep time) / total cycle time. Convert µA to mA first: 1,000 µA = 1 mA. Usable capacity = rated capacity × usable fraction; runtime in hours = usable mAh / average mA.</p><p>The currents must be measured at the battery, including the board, sensors and regulator losses. The awake value is the average over the whole wake-up, measurement and transmission period. Sleep time is additional to awake time. This simple model excludes self-discharge, temperature and changing battery voltage, so very long runtimes are especially optimistic.</p></details>
  <p class="demo-note">The defaults are illustrative, not measurements of the course board. Use measured total battery-side currents for your own project. Hardware configuration matters; see the <a href="https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/stable/esp32/api-reference/system/sleep_modes.html">ESP32 sleep-mode documentation</a>.</p>
  <div class="demo-footer"><p><strong>Try:</strong> Halve the awake time. Reset, then halve the sleep current. Which saves more with these example values?</p><button type="button" data-reset>Reset</button></div>
  <noscript><p>Enable JavaScript to use the calculator. With the example values, average current is 2.715 mA and 1,600 usable mAh gives about 24.6 days.</p></noscript>
</div>
```
